         <div class="content">
            <p class="TOCHeading">
               <span>TABLE OF CONTENTS</span>
            </p>
            <p class="TOC5">
               <span>ANNEX I</span><span>
                  <br/>Strategic sectors for industrial manufacturing acceleration areas</span><span>
                  <span class="tab">   </span></span><span>2</span>
            </p>
            <p class="TOC5">
               <span>ANNEX II</span><span>
                  <br/>Low-carbon and Union origin requirements for energy intensive industries </span><span>
                  <span class="tab">   </span></span><span>2</span>
            </p>
            <p class="li TOC2">
               <span class="num"><span>Part I – Public procurement procedures</span></span><span>2</span>
            </p>
            <p class="li TOC2">
               <span class="num"><span>Part II – Other forms of public intervention</span></span><span>2</span>
            </p>
            <p class="TOC5">
               <span>ANNEX III</span><span>
                  <br/>Union origin requirements for vehicles</span><span>
                  <span class="tab">   </span></span><span>4</span>
            </p>
            <p class="li TOC2">
               <span class="num"><span>Part I – Public procurement procedures of electric vehicles</span></span><span>4</span>
            </p>
            <p class="li TOC2">
               <span class="num"><span>Part II – Other forms of public intervention and financial support for corporate vehicles</span></span><span>5</span>
            </p>
            <p class="li TOC2">
               <span class="num"><span>Part III – Super credits for small zero-emission vehicles</span></span><span>6</span>
            </p>
            <p class="TOC5">
               <span>ANNEX IV</span><span>
                  <br/>Amendment to Regulation (EU) 2018/1724</span><span>
                  <span class="tab">   </span></span><span>7</span>
            </p>
            <p id="_TocB8B830563AB44505965AD59E2CAFC3DE" class="Annexetitre">
               <span>ANNEX I</span>
               <br/>
               <span>Strategic sectors</span><span> for industrial manufacturing acceleration areas</span>
            </p>
            <p class="li NumPar1">
               <span><span class="num">1.</span></span><span>Energy-intensive industries:</span>
            </p>
            <p class="li Point1letter">
               <span><span class="num">(a)</span></span><span>Manufacture of paper and paper products, as classified under NACE Code C17;</span>
            </p>
            <p class="li Point1letter">
               <span><span class="num">(b)</span></span><span>Manufacture of coke and refined petroleum products, as classified under NACE Code C19;</span>
            </p>
            <p class="li Point1letter">
               <span><span class="num">(c)</span></span><span>Manufacture of chemicals and chemical products, as classified under NACE Code C20;</span>
            </p>
            <p class="li Point1letter">
               <span><span class="num">(d)</span></span><span>Manufacture of rubber and plastic products, as classified under NACE Code C22;</span>
            </p>
            <p class="li Point1letter">
               <span><span class="num">(e)</span></span><span>Manufacture of other non-metallic minerals, as classified under NACE Code C23</span><span>;</span>
            </p>
            <p class="li Point1letter">
               <span><span class="num">(f)</span></span><span>Manufacture of basic metals, as classified under NACE Code C24.</span>
            </p>
            <p class="li NumPar1">
               <span><span class="num">2.</span></span><span>Automotive industry: Manufacture of motor vehicles, trailers and semi-trailers, as </span><span>classified under NACE Code C29; </span>
            </p>
         </div>
         <div class="content">
            <p class="li NumPar1">
               <span><span class="num">3.</span></span><span>Net-zero technologies, as referred to in Article 4(1) of Regulation (EU) 2024/1735;</span>
            </p>
            <p id="_Toc7EBBCFB0C80F4BAFB4B808BE2D320AF1" class="Annexetitre">
               <span>ANNEX I</span><span>I</span>
               <br/>
               <span>Low-carbon</span><span> and</span><span> Union</span><span> </span><span>origin requirements for energy intensive industries </span>
            </p>
            <p class="li ManualHeading2">
               <span>Part I – Public procurement procedures</span>
            </p>
            <p class="Normal">
               <span>Where, in the context of public procurement procedures launched on or after 1 January 2029 falling within the scope of Directives 2014/23/EU, 2014/24/EU or 2014/25/EU, where the contracts, works contracts or work concessions include the procurement of products from energy intensive industries, contracting authorities shall require the following minimum percentage shares:  </span>
            </p>
            <p class="li Point1letter">
               <span><span class="num">(a)</span></span><span>Steel, and any product </span><span>the performance of which depends mainly on steel, intended for use in buildings, infrastructure and</span><span> </span><span>motor</span><span> </span><span>vehicles</span><span> for civil purposes</span><span>: at least 25% of the total volume of steel used</span><span> shall be low-carbon</span><span>; </span>
            </p>
            <p class="li Point1letter">
               <span><span class="num">(b)</span></span><span>concrete and mortar, and any product the performance of which depends mainly on concrete and mortar, intended for use in buildings and infrastructure</span><span> for civil purposes</span><span>: at least </span><span>5% </span><span>of the total volume of concrete and mortar used</span><span>, including</span><span> the </span><span>clinker and cement used to </span><span>produce them,</span><span> shall be low-carbon and of Union</span><span> </span><span>origin</span><span>; </span>
            </p>
            <p class="li Point1letter">
               <span><span class="num">(c)</span></span><span>aluminium, and any product the performance of which depends mainly on aluminium, intended for use in buildings, infrastructure and </span><span>motor</span><span> </span><span>vehicles</span><span> </span><span>for civil purposes</span><span>: at least 25% of the total volume of aluminium used</span><span> shall be low-carbon and of Union</span><span> </span><span>origi</span><span>n.</span>
            </p>
            <p class="li ManualHeading2">
               <span>Part II – Other forms of public intervention</span>
            </p>
            <p class="Normal">
               <span>For schemes established or updated on or after 1 January 2029 that benefit households or companies and that primarily aim to support the construction or renovation of buildings for residential and commercial purposes and infrastructure and the lease and purchase of motor vehicles for civil purposes, Member States, regional or local authorities, bodies governed by public law or associations formed by one or more such authorities or one or more such bodies governed by public law, shall ensure that only beneficiaries that comply with the following minimum requirements, are eligible.</span>
            </p>
            <p class="li Point1letter">
               <span><span class="num">(a)</span></span><span>steel, and any product the performance of which depends primarily on steel</span><span> </span><span>: at least 25% of the total volume of steel used in the product or project that receives support</span><span> shall be low-carbon</span><span>;</span>
            </p>
            <p class="li Point1letter">
               <span><span class="num">(b)</span></span><span>concrete and mortar, and any product the performance of which depends mainly on concrete and mortar: at least </span><span>5%</span><span> of the total volume of concrete and mortar </span><span>used</span><span>, </span><span>including the clinker and cement used to produce them,</span><span> </span><span>in the</span><span> product or project that receives support</span><span> shall be low-carbon and of Union</span><span> </span><span>origin</span><span>;</span>
            </p>
            <p class="li Point1letter">
               <span><span class="num">(c)</span></span><span>aluminium, and any product the performance of which depends mainly on aluminium: at least 25% of the total volume of aluminium used in the product or project that receives support</span><span> shall be low-carbon and of Union</span><span> </span><span>origin</span><span>.</span>
            </p>
            <p id="_TocD71C84F4FBD1462EB08F66799B80DBAF" class="Annexetitre">
               <span>ANNEX II</span><span>I</span>
               <br/>
               <span>Union origin requirements for vehicles</span>
            </p>
            <p class="li ManualHeading2">
               <span>Part I – Public procurement procedures of electric vehicles</span>
            </p>
            <p class="Normal">
               <span>New pure electric vehicles (PEV), off-vehicle charging hybrid electric vehicles (OVC-HEV) or fuel cell vehicles (FCV) purchased, leased, rented or hire-purchased in public procurement procedures that fall within the scope of Directive 2014/24/EU, or Directive 2014/25/EU, launched on or after [OP: Please insert the date = six months after the date of entry into force of this Regulation] shall comply with the Union origin requirements set out in this Annex.</span>
            </p>
            <p class="Normal">
               <span>New PEV, OVC-HEV and FCV that are used for the provision of services sourced through public procurement procedures that fall within the scope of Directive 2014/24/EU, or Directive 2014/25/EU, shall comply with the Union origin requirements set out in this Annex.</span>
            </p>
            <p class="Normal">
               <span>Vehicles referred to in subparagraphs 1 and 2 shall include the following Union origin requirements:</span>
            </p>
            <p class="li Point1letter">
               <span><span class="num">(a)</span></span><span>the vehicle is assembled within the Union;</span>
            </p>
            <p class="li Point1letter">
               <span><span class="num">(b)</span></span><span>the ratio between the total ex-works price of </span><span>vehicle </span><span>components - excluding the vehicle battery - originating in the Union and the total ex-works price of all components – excluding the battery – is </span><span>at least</span><span> 70%;</span>
            </p>
            <p class="li Point1letter">
               <span><span class="num">(c)</span></span><span>the vehicle’s traction battery contains at least </span><span>three</span><span> </span><span>main specific </span><span>componen</span><span>ts</span><span> of batteries</span><span>, among which the battery cells, originating in the Union;</span>
            </p>
         </div>
         <div class="content">
            <p class="li Point1letter">
               <span><span class="num">(d)</span></span><span>the vehicle’s traction battery contains at least </span><span>five</span><span> </span><span>main specific </span><span>componen</span><span>ts</span><span> of batteries</span><span>, among which the battery cells, the cathode active material, and the battery management system, originating in the Union</span><span>;</span>
            </p>
            <p class="li Point1letter">
               <span><span class="num">(e)</span></span><span>the ratio between the total ex-works price of e-powertrain components originating in the Union and the total ex-works price of all e-powertrain components is </span><span>at least </span><span>50%;</span>
            </p>
            <p class="li Point1letter">
               <span><span class="num">(f)</span></span><span>the ratio between the total ex-works price of main electronic systems originating in the Union and the total ex-works price of all main electronic systems is equal to or greater than 50%</span><span>.</span>
            </p>
            <p class="Normal">
               <span>The requirements set out in points d), e) and f) apply from [OP: please insert date 3 years after the date of entry into force of this Regulation].</span>
            </p>
            <p class="Normal">
               <span>By way of derogation to the requirements set out above, small electric vehicles of subcategory M1E, as defined in Regulation (EU) 2018/858, shall include the following Union origin requirements:</span>
            </p>
            <p class="li NumPar1">
               <span><span class="num">1.</span></span><span>the vehicle is assembled within the Union;</span>
            </p>
            <p class="li NumPar1">
               <span><span class="num">2.</span></span><span>and one of the two criteria below:</span>
            </p>
            <p class="li Point1letter">
               <span><span class="num">(a)</span></span><span>the ratio between the total ex-works price of </span><span>vehicle componen</span><span>ts - excluding the vehicle battery - originating in the Union and the total ex-works price of all </span><span>vehicle componen</span><span>ts – excluding the battery – is equal to or greater than 70%; or </span>
            </p>
            <p class="li Point1letter">
               <span><span class="num">(b)</span></span><span>the vehicle’s traction battery contains at least three main specific </span><span>componen</span><span>ts</span><span> of batteries</span><span>, among which the battery cells, originating in the Union.</span>
            </p>
            <p class="Normal">
               <span>Upon request of a vehicle manufacturer, all PEV, OVC-HEV or FCV from that vehicle manufacturer can be considered compliant, for a period of twelve months, with the Union origin requirements if the manufacturer demonstrates that the total number of all PEV, OVC-HEC or FCV vehicles compliant with the Union origin requirements that were assembled by that vehicle manufacturer during the period comprised between 1 January and 31 December (included) of the previous year represent a percentage equal or greater than 85% of the total number of PEV, OVC-HEV or FCV from the same vehicle manufacturer that were registered within the Union in the same period.  </span>
            </p>
            <p class="Normal">
               <span>Where public procurement procedures concern public service contracts referred to in subparagraph 2, vehicles already registered in the Union shall be deemed to comply with the requirements set out in this Annex until 31 December 2035.</span>
            </p>
            <p class="li ManualHeading2">
               <span>Part II – Other forms of public intervention and financial support for corporate vehicles</span>
            </p>
            <p class="Normal">
               <span>For schemes established or updated after [OP: Please insert the date = six months after the date of entry into force of this Regulation] that support the purchase, lease, rent or hire-purchase of new PEV, OVC-HEV or FCV, Member States, regional or local authorities, bodies governed by public law or associations formed by one or more such authorities or one or more such bodies governed by public law shall ensure that only vehicles that comply with the below minimum Union origin requirements are eligible under the scheme.</span>
            </p>
            <p class="Normal">
               <span>For the purpose of considering corporate cars and vans ‘made in the European Union’ in accordance with Article 4 of the [Proposal for a Regulation of 16 December 2025 on clean corporate vehicles], the below requirements apply.</span>
            </p>
            <p class="li Point1letter">
               <span><span class="num">(a)</span></span><span>the vehicle is assembled within the Union;</span>
            </p>
            <p class="li Point1letter">
               <span><span class="num">(a)</span></span><span>the ratio between the total ex-works price of </span><span>vehicle componen</span><span>ts - excluding the vehicle battery - originating in the Union and the total ex-works price of all </span><span>vehicle componen</span><span>ts – excluding the battery – is equal to or greater than 70%;</span>
            </p>
            <p class="li Point1letter">
               <span><span class="num">(b)</span></span><span>the vehicle’s traction battery contains at least </span><span>three </span><span>main specific </span><span>componen</span><span>ts</span><span> of batteries</span><span>, among which the battery cells, originating in the Union;</span>
            </p>
            <p class="li Point1letter">
               <span><span class="num">(c)</span></span><span>the vehicle’s traction battery contains at least </span><span>five </span><span>main specific </span><span>componen</span><span>ts</span><span> of batteries</span><span>, among which the battery cells, the cathode active material, and the battery management system, originating in the Union</span><span>;</span>
            </p>
            <p class="li Point1letter">
               <span><span class="num">(d)</span></span><span>the ratio between the total ex-works price of e-powertrain components originating in the Union and the total ex-works price of all e-powertrain components is equal to or greater than 50%;</span>
            </p>
            <p class="li Point1letter">
               <span><span class="num">(e)</span></span><span>the ratio between the total ex-works price of main electronic systems originating in the Union and the total ex-works price of all main electronic systems is equal to or greater than 50%</span><span>.</span>
            </p>
         </div>
         <div class="content">
            <p class="Normal">
               <span>The requirements set out in points d), e) and f) apply from [OP: please insert date three years after the date of entry into force of this Regulation].</span>
            </p>
            <p class="Normal">
               <span>By way of derogation to the requirements set out above, small electric vehicles of subcategory M1E, as defined in Regulation (EU) 2018/858, shall include the following Union origin requirements:</span>
            </p>
            <p class="Normal">
               <span>1.</span><span>
                  <span class="tab">   </span>the vehicle is assembled within the Union</span><span>; </span>
            </p>
            <p class="Normal">
               <span>2.</span><span>
                  <span class="tab">   </span></span><span>one of the two criteria below:</span>
            </p>
            <p class="li Point1letter">
               <span><span class="num">(a)</span></span><span>the ratio between the total ex-works price of </span><span>vehicle componen</span><span>ts - excluding the vehicle battery - originating in the Union and the total ex-works price of all </span><span>vehicle componen</span><span>ts – excluding the battery – is equal to or greater than 70%; or </span>
            </p>
            <p class="li Point1letter">
               <span><span class="num">(b)</span></span><span>the vehicle’s traction battery contains at least three main specific </span><span>componen</span><span>ts</span><span> of batteries</span><span>, among which the battery cells, originating in the Union.</span>
            </p>
            <p class="Normal">
               <span>Upon request of a vehicle manufacturer, all PEV, OVC-HEV or FCV from that vehicle manufacturer can be considered compliant, for a period of twelve months, with the Un ion origin requirements if the manufacturer demonstrates that all PEV, OVC-HEV or FCV compliant with the Union origin requirements that were assembled by that vehicle manufacturer during the period comprised between 1 January and 31 December (included) of the previous year represent a percentage equal or greater than 85% of the total number of PEV, OVC-HEV or FCV from the same vehicle manufacturer that were registered within the Union in the same period.  </span>
            </p>
            <p class="li ManualHeading2">
               <span>Part III – Super credits for small zero-emission vehicles</span>
            </p>
            <p class="Normal">
               <span>For the purpose of considering vehicles as “made in the EU” in accordance with Article 5 of Regulation (EU) 2019/631 [as amended by the Proposal for a Regulation of 16 December 2025 amending Regulation (EU) 2019/631 as regards CO2 emission performance standards for new light duty vehicles and vehicle labelling], the following criteria apply:</span>
            </p>
            <p class="li NumPar1">
               <span><span class="num">1.</span></span><span>the vehicle is assembled within the Union;</span>
            </p>
            <p class="li NumPar1">
               <span><span class="num">2.</span></span><span>and one of the two criteria below:</span>
            </p>
            <p class="li Point1letter">
               <span><span class="num">(a)</span></span><span>the ratio between the total ex-works price of </span><span>vehicle componen</span><span>ts - excluding the vehicle battery - originating in the Union and the total ex-works price of all </span><span>vehicle componen</span><span>ts – excluding the battery – is equal to or greater than 70%</span><span>; </span><span>or </span>
            </p>
            <p class="li Point1letter">
               <span><span class="num">(b)</span></span><span>the vehicle’s traction battery contains at least three main specific </span><span>componen</span><span>ts</span><span> of batteries</span><span>, among which the battery cells, originating in the Union.</span>
            </p>
            <p id="_Toc72C3D5F66D804A559BEF6B5DB6500FFA" class="Annexetitre">
               <span>ANNEX </span><span>I</span><span>V</span>
               <br/>
               <span>Amendment to Regulation </span><span>(EU) </span><span>2018</span><span>/1724</span>
            </p>
            <p class="Normal">
               <span>Annexes I and II are amended as follows:</span>
            </p>
            <p class="li NumPar1">
               <span><span class="num">1.</span></span><span>Annex I is amended as follows:</span>
            </p>
            <p class="li Point1letter">
               <span><span class="num">(a)</span></span><span>the following row ‘Permit-granting procedures’ is added </span><span>in</span><span> the table</span><span> for ‘Areas </span><span>of information related to businesses</span><span>’ </span><span>before </span><span>the row ‘AJ. Critical raw materials projects’</span><span>:</span>
            </p>
            <table>
               <tr>
                  <td>
                     <p class="Normal">
                        <span>‘Permit granting processes</span>
                     </p>
                  </td>
                  <td>
                     <p class="Normal">
                        <span>Information on permit-granting procedures for industrial manufacturing projects including Net-zero technology manufacturing and critical raw material projects.’;</span>
                     </p>
                  </td>
               </tr>
            </table>
            <p class="li Point1letter">
               <span><span class="num">(b)</span></span><span>in row ‘R. Net-zero technology manufacturing projects’, in the second column, point 1 is deleted; </span>
            </p>
            <p class="li Point1letter">
               <span><span class="num">(c)</span></span><span>in row ‘AJ. Critical raw materials projects’, in the second column, point 2 is deleted; </span>
            </p>
         </div>
         <div class="content">
            <p class="li NumPar1">
               <span><span class="num">2.</span></span><span>Annex II is amended as follows:</span>
            </p>
            <p class="li Point1letter">
               <span><span class="num">(a)</span></span><span>row ‘Starting, running, and closing business’ is amended as follows:</span>
            </p>
            <p class="li Point2letter">
               <span><span class="num">(a)</span></span><span>in the second column, the following second subparagraph is added:</span>
            </p>
            <p class="Text3">
               <span>‘Permission for exercising a business activity, including procedures related to all relevant permits to build and operate critical raw materials projects</span><span class="FootnoteReference">
                  <a class="footnoteRef" id="footnoteref2" href="#footnote2">1</a>
               </span><span>, procedures for all relevant permits to build, expand, convert and operate net-zero technology manufacturing projects</span><span class="FootnoteReference">
                  <a class="footnoteRef" id="footnoteref3" href="#footnote3">2</a>
               </span><span>, and procedures related to industrial manufacturing projects.’;  </span>
            </p>
            <p class="li Point2letter">
               <span><span class="num">(b)</span></span><span>in the third column, the following second subparagraph is added: </span>
            </p>
            <p class="Text3">
               <span>‘Confirmation of the request for permission for business activity, as well as all outputs pertaining to the procedures related to critical raw material, net-zero technology manufacturing and manufacturing industry projects (ranging from the acknowledgement that the application is complete to the notification of the comprehensive decision on the outcome of the procedure, including by the designated contact point).’; </span>
            </p>
            <p class="li Point1letter">
               <span><span class="num">(b)</span></span><span>rows</span><span> </span><span>‘Critical raw materials projects’ and ‘Net-zero technology manufacturing projects’ are deleted.</span>
            </p>
         </div>
         <div class="content">
            <dl id="footnotes">
               <dd id="footnote2">
                  <span class="num">
                     <a class="footnote" href="#footnoteref2">(1)</a>
                  </span><span>
                     <span class="tab">   </span></span><span>Procedure related to all relevant permits to build and operate critical raw materials projects, including building, chemical and grid connection permits and environmental assessments and authorisations where these are required, and encompassing all applications and procedures from the acknowledgment that the application is complete to the notification of the comprehensive decision on the outcome of the procedure by the single point of contact concerned pursuant to Art</span><span>icle 9 of Regulation (EU) 2024/1252.</span>
               </dd>
               <dd id="footnote3">
                  <span class="num">
                     <a class="footnote" href="#footnoteref3">(2)</a>
                  </span><span>
                     <span class="tab">   </span></span><span>Procedures for all relevant permits to build, expand, convert and operate netzero technology manufacturing projects, and net-zero strategic projects, including building, chemical and grid connection permits, environmental assessments and authorisations where required, and encompassing all applications and procedures. </span>
               </dd>
            </dl>
         </div>
